# Roadmap (Now / Next / Later)

Owner: **Product Manager**. No roadmap item without an owner, a success metric, and a time horizon. "Someday" is not a roadmap item.

```markdown
# Product Roadmap — [Team / Product Area] — [Quarter Year]

## 🌟 North Star Metric
[Single metric capturing user value + business health]
**Current**: [value]  **Target EOY**: [value]

## 🟢 Now — Active This Quarter
| Initiative | User Problem | Platform | Backend | Metric + Target | Owner | Status | ETA |

## 🟡 Next — Next 1–2 Quarters
| Initiative | Hypothesis (If X → users will Y) | Platform | Backend | Confidence | Blocker |

## 🔵 Later — 3–6 Month Horizon
| Initiative | Strategic Hypothesis | Platform | Signal Needed to Advance |

## ❌ What We're Not Building (and Why)
| Request | Source | Reason (incl. stack constraint) | Revisit Condition |
```
